name: Butler Nongame Species Fund (Wyoming Wildlife Foundation)
summary: Grants for Wyoming projects that conserve nongame wildlife and the habitats they depend on, through habitat restoration and conservation. Most awards are between $1,000 and $5,000.

eligibility.rule: Applying through an organization rather than directly as an individual
Submitting a final report before a new request if previously funded

documents: Project budget, unless requesting general operating funds
Organization budget for the current or following fiscal year
Most recently completed fiscal year-end income statement
Most recently completed fiscal year-end balance sheet
Fiscal sponsorship letter, if using another organization's nonprofit status
Fiscal sponsor's financial information, if using a fiscal sponsor

status.quote: Butler Nongame Species Fund Status Closed County All Counties Opens June 15, 2026 Deadline September 15, 2026

administered_by.quote: the fund-administered by the Wyoming Wildlife Foundation-provides grants

applicant_types.quote: Nonprofit organizations exempt from federal taxation under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.

geography.quote: provides grants for projects that conserve Wyoming's 554 nongame species through habitat restoration, conservation, and other impactful initiatives.

access.quote: WYCF accepts one application per organization per grant deadline.

amount.quote: Most grant amounts awarded are between $1,000-$5,000, with other amounts considered.

effort.quote: There is no time limit on entering data in the online application

eligibility.quote: We are not able to provide funding directly to individuals.
If you have previously received funding, a final report must be submitted prior to submitting a new grant request.

after_award.quote: Unless otherwise stated in the award letter, all grant recipients must turn in a final report.

documents.quote: Project Budget - Your project budget may be submitted in any format but you must include projected expenses and revenues.
Organization Budget - You must submit your total annual budget for the current fiscal year, unless the program occurs in the following year; then submit the following year's budget.

We would like your most recently completed fiscal year end (FYE) Income Statement. You may submit this piece as an Excel spreadsheet, PDF, or Word document. Board of Directors List - Please include a current list of all members of your organization's board of directors.
We would like your most recently completed fiscal year end (FYE) Balance Sheet.

If you do not have your own 501(c)(3), and you are using another organization's nonprofit status, we require a letter of fiscal sponsorship stating that grants received will be managed by the nonprofit organization. We will also need your fiscal sponsor's financial information.
